title: 第13章 闯山门第14章 强大邪灵就这
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
牛铁锤看了一眼儿子，得意道：“所以你知道，我为什么这么主动抱大腿了吧？”
牛五方重重点头道：“明白了！
这是在抱未来武帝的大腿啊！”
牛铁锤叹口气道：“咱们五色神牛一族，太惨了！
这些年，被追杀、被奴役、被人当坐骑！
我都逃到这种地方来了，居然还会被人封印五百年。
这种悲惨的牛生，我是再也不想过了！”
“而他，就是我们逆天改命的唯一机会！”
牛五方深吸一口气，道：“我懂了母亲，我这就去罗家！
可恶……就算拼了命，我也不会让罗家任何一人受到伤害！”
牛铁锤点头道：“没错，这是他交给我们的第一件事，绝不可以办砸了！”
另一边。
阿嚏！
身在炎雀上的罗天，不由自主打了个喷嚏。
这个喷嚏，把炎雀吓得浑身一抖。
“大人，我是飞得太快了么？”
他颤声问道。
此刻的炎雀，对罗天无比畏惧。
不单单是因为牛铁锤母子，对罗天的态度。
更重要的是，当罗天坐在他身上的时候，炎雀感受到一股异常恐怖的压迫感。

那感觉，自己并不是背着一个人类。
而更像是背着一尊强大无比的神佛。
罗天每呼吸一次，都仿佛牵动了某种天地规则。
让炎雀有一种随时都会被拍死的感觉。
自己好歹也是御空境的妖兽啊。
只能说，罗天太强大了。
罗天哪里知道，自己只是在空中无聊，在空中默默修炼了几下天道呼吸法，就差点把炎雀给吓死了。
“不快，还有多久才到？”
罗天说道。
“再往前几十里，就到地明宗的山门了，大人，地明宗有些复杂，我一个妖兽，不方便前往……”
炎雀小心翼翼的说道。
“哦？那好，你将我放下即可。”
罗天淡淡道。
“好！
好！”
content_en:
Niu Tiechui glanced at his son and said proudly: "So you know why I took the initiative to hug my thigh, right?"
Niu Wufang nodded heavily and said: "I understand!
This is hugging the lap of the future Emperor Wu! "
Niu Tiechui sighed and said: "Our five-color sacred cow clan is so miserable!
Over the years, I have been hunted, enslaved, and used as a mount!
I have fled to a place like this, and yet I will be sealed away for five hundred years.
I never want to live such a miserable life again! "
"And he is our only chance to change our fate against the odds!"
Niu Wufang took a deep breath and said, "I understand, mother, I'm going to Luo's house right now!
Damn it...even if I risk my life, I won't let anyone in the Luo family get hurt! "
Niu Tiechui nodded and said: "Yes, this is the first thing he gave us. We must not fail!"
other side.
Ah sneeze!
Luo Tian, ​​who was on the Flame Bird, sneezed involuntarily.
This sneeze made Yanque tremble all over.
"Sir, am I flying too fast?"
he asked shakily.
At this moment, Yanque was extremely afraid of Luo Tian.
Not only because of Niu Tiechui mother and son's attitude towards Luo Tian.
More importantly, when Luo Tian sat on him, Yan Que felt an extremely terrifying sense of oppression.
It felt like I wasn't carrying a human being on my back.
It's more like carrying an extremely powerful god and Buddha on his back.
Every time Luo Tian took a breath, it seemed that some kind of law of heaven and earth was affected.
It makes Yanque feel like it will be shot to death at any time.
After all, he is also a monster in the Sky Control Realm.
It can only be said that Luo Tian is too powerful.
How did Luo Tian know that he was just bored in the air and practiced the Heavenly Dao Breathing Technique silently for a few times in the air, which almost scared the Yanque to death.
"No, how long until we arrive?"
Luo Tian said.
"A few dozen miles further, we will reach the mountain gate of Diming Sect. Sir, Diming Sect is a bit complicated. It is inconvenient for me, a monster, to go there..."
Yanque said cautiously.
"Oh? Well, just put me down."
Luo Tian said lightly.
"well!"
